In verse 35, the violence of the mob was so great that Paul had to be carried by soldiers ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀναβαθμούς—up the stairs to the barracks. Verse 40 states that Paul, standing ἐπὶ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν—on the stairs—motioned to the crowd for silence. These stairs connected the temple courts to the Fortress Antonia, the Roman garrison overlooking the temple mount. Luke's precise topographical detail places the scene vividly in Jerusalem's architecture."
